e.title: VTC AI 保险领导力课程
e.summary: 香港 VTC 专业课程：保险与金融专业人士的 AI 领导力（新兴趋势与创新）
e.body: VTC（香港职业训练局）持续进修课程「AI Leadership for Insurance and Financial Professionals」模块 3：Emerging Trends and Innovations——香港本地的保险 AI 专业发展课程。对 RIAA：香港保险 AI 的本地进修——与 [[ashk-examination]]（ASHK 本地资格）配套：本地职业发展双路径；理解香港保险 AI 的培训供给（CPD/进修）；「AI 领导力」是职业进阶的方向；本地求职的持续学习素材。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：VTC 官网确认（AI 保险领导力课程），未报名
e.title_hk: VTC AI 保險領導力課程
e.summary_en: HK VTC professional course: AI leadership for insurance and financial professionals (emerging trends & innovations)
e.summary_hk: 香港 VTC 專業課程：保險與金融專業人士的 AI 領導力（新興趨勢與創新）
e.body_en: The VTC (Vocational Training Council, HK) continuing-education course 'AI Leadership for Insurance and Financial Professionals' Module 3: Emerging Trends and Innovations — a HK-local professional-development course on insurance AI. For RIAA: local HK continuing education on insurance AI — paired with [[ashk-examination]] (ASHK local qualification): the dual path of local professional development; understand HK's training supply of insurance AI (CPD/continuing education); 'AI leadership' as a career-advancement direction; continuous-learning material for local job hunting.
e.body_hk: VTC（香港職業訓練局）持續進修課程「AI Leadership for Insurance and Financial Professionals」模塊 3：Emerging Trends and Innovations——香港本地的保險 AI 專業發展課程。對 RIAA：香港保險 AI 的本地進修——與 [[ashk-examination]]（ASHK 本地資格）配套：本地職業發展雙路徑；理解香港保險 AI 的培訓供給（CPD/進修）；「AI 領導力」是職業進階的方向；本地求職的持續學習素材。
